breakdown.description: The sinusoidal traction is moved from the specified global x-coordinate to a local edge coordinate
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed the agent to parameterize the sinusoidal traction using a local arclength coordinate. The ground truth corrects this, specifying that the global x-coordinate should be used. The generated specification repeated the error from the incomplete prompt, stating to use 'the local arclength coordinate s' and to 'Parameterize the traction as t_s(s) = -5e3 * sin(π * s / L) Pa'.
